features.quote: If the Repetition Ratio (RR) > 0.9 for 3 consecutive turns, terminate the run early.
features.justification_quote: The failure is confirmed; no need to burn tokens for the remaining 20 turns.

features.quote: Why Early Stopping? Once a model enters a repetitive loop, it rarely self-recovers.
features.justification_quote: Continuing the run generates low-value noise data and increases API costs without improving the eval signal.
